name: Charlatan
description:
You are able to wear Mesmer's masks, a special equipment type. To gain a new mask, you must spend 30 XP in addition to its cost in treasure.

When you gain a mask, choose an ability at random from that mask's domain without looking at it, placing it face-down under the mask. Roll the mask's Discovery Skill to set the Discovery Number for that ability.

You may attempt to discover this ability via your Performance ability. Once you gain an ability through discovery, you may use it regardless of which mask you are wearing.

Once per day per mask you have, you may choose a new ability to place face-down under a mask, rolling a new Discovery Number.

If you have discovered at least one ability under a mask's domain, that mask is magically adhered to your face while you are wearing it and cannot be removed except by you. Putting on or removing a mask costs a half action.
